subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `after_compaction` hooks gain a supported core `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` contract, limited to the current canonical session and lifecycle-owned deferred execution?
rationale: This adds permanent plugin API and session-lifecycle policy; code review can verify mechanics, but only an owner can approve that extension boundary and its long-term compatibility obligations.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow API
options.body: Approve the current-session-only contract after notification handling, scope cleanup, focused compatibility tests, and final-head real behavior proof are completed.

options.title: Keep reset owner-internal
options.body: Remove the public hook API and expose session recovery only through bundled owner-specific compaction or context-engine seams.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Close or defer the PR until a broader plugin session-lifecycle API is designed with explicit ownership and upgrade guarantees.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow API
recommendation.body: Approve the current-session-only contract after notification handling, scope cleanup, focused compatibility tests, and final-head real behavior proof are completed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most directly connects him to the plugin-hook contract and lifecycle architecture that must own this API decision.
